title: US: AI in healthcare rules
summary: FDA loosened oversight of some clinical decision support (CDS) software, Jan 2026 (verify current version). HHS AI Strategy (Dec 2025) has workforce development as a pillar. ONC proposed removing "AI model card" transparency (verify status). Texas laws (Sept 2025 / Jan 2026) require telling patients when AI is used and reviewing AI-generated records.
fact: Lighter federal oversight shifts judgment onto the clinician.
caution: Binding? FDA guidance non-binding; Texas laws binding in Texas. Never imply foreign rules bind Armenian or Gulf hospitals.
